v101Acceptance.criterion: No regression in the v1.0.0 core workflow
Release ZIP contains only required plugin files
Batch processing, retry, recovery, Auto Save, and JPEG export pass manual verification
No leaked live Photoshop document references after completion
Changelog and release notes are updated

runtimeScenarios.fixtureRule: Use only a disposable copied project and copied PSD/JPEG fixtures.
runtimeScenarios.procedure: Create or open a copied project, open its copied photo folder, register copied PSD templates, select photos, process the batch, cancel one copied run at a safe boundary, resume or retry safe work, and verify Save Copy PSD plus JPEG outputs.
runtimeScenarios.pass: Project state persists; template order, placement, progress, cancel/resume/retry, Save Copy PSD, and JPEG outputs match the operator UI with no ambiguous output state.
runtimeScenarios.evidence: PASS in ALB-053 using a disposable copied project and copied PSD/JPEG fixtures.

runtimeScenarios.fixtureRule: Use only disposable copied PSD fixtures; never force unsafe host or filesystem failures.
runtimeScenarios.procedure: Run success, invalid/unreadable copied PSD, cancellation, and safe failure paths; after every terminal outcome inspect Photoshop documents and then close the project.
runtimeScenarios.pass: No AlbumAI-opened template document or queued document reference remains after the terminal outcome or project close.
runtimeScenarios.evidence: PASS in ALB-053: invalid PSD rejected, terminal references released, and project close cleared AlbumAI state.
